verdict: Yes. The Cinnamon Kitchen from Chandigarh pitched plant-based healthy snacks on Shark Tank India Season 3 and got a deal. Vegan and plant-based snacks appeal to health-conscious and ethical buyers, and many traditional Indian snacks are already plant-based.
angle: Plant-based cookies, bars and savoury snacks sell to vegan and health-conscious buyers. Cafés, gyms and online stores are good channels. Clean ingredients and taste are what bring buyers back.
